A '''blaster''' thought to have been once owned by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Freedon Nadd]] said to have killed more [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] than any [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] was thought of as a "vile weapon".

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, in order to use the weapon, a character has to be aligned with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and of a Sith prestige class ([[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith Assassin]] or [[Sith Marauder]]).
